description: Use when implementing client-side routing, navigation, or URL parameter handling in SolidJS applications. Prevents incorrect router setup, misused navigation hooks, and non-lazy-loaded route bundles. Covers Router/HashRouter setup, A component, useNavigate, useParams, useSearchParams, useBeforeLeave, lazy loading, route preloading, and config-based routing.
